raw.title: UX Researcher
raw.excerpt: Meet SlingshotAt Slingshot Aerospace, we're on a mission to make space safer and more secure for everyone.
raw.description:
Meet Slingshot

At Slingshot Aerospace, we're on a mission to make space safer and more secure for everyone. Our work directly impacts global security, disaster response, climate monitoring, and the critical infrastructure that connects our world. We're a team of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers who believe that the next generation of space operations will be powered by better data and smarter software. We move fast, we're not afraid to fail, and we believe the best ideas can come from anywhere—whether you're in engineering, sales, product, or operations. If you want to work on something that truly matters, with people who care deeply about the impact we're making and help shape the future of an industry that's just getting started, you're in the right place.

What You’ll Be Launching

We're looking for a UX Researcher who thrives in complex problem spaces and cares deeply about creating seamless, effective, and meaningful experiences for users in high-stakes environments. In this role, you’ll be a key advocate for the voice of the user—championing research-driven design decisions across multiple product teams.

Depending on level and scope, UX Researchers may focus on:

  • Usability and Tactical Research – validating workflows and UI patterns
  • Strategic and Generative Research – surfacing new opportunities and behavioral trends
  • Research Ops and Enablement – building systems and frameworks for scalable research

At more senior levels, this role leads high-impact initiatives, contributes to product and business strategy, and advocates for research across the organization.

We're building a team of sharp, creative people who love solving hard problems. We value curiosity over ego, initiative over waiting for permission, and people who genuinely care about doing great work. Bring your expertise, your fresh ideas, and your drive—we'll bring the rocket fuel.

Your Mission (Should you choose to accept it)

Discovery & Study Design

  • Take ownership of end-to-end research studies, including scoping, participant recruitment, methodology selection, facilitation, and analysis, across the full product lifecycle.
  • Frame research questions that address product uncertainties and business goals in collaboration with product, design, engineering, and growth.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning by surfacing user needs, pain points, and opportunity areas grounded in data.

Research Execution & Insight Generation

  • Conduct mixed-methods research (e.g., interviews, usability tests, surveys, field studies, A/B testing, etc.) and synthesize findings into clear, actionable insights.
  • Support product teams with rapid evaluative testing, continuous discovery practices, and post-launch learnings.
  • Partner with data analysts and designers to triangulate findings and ensure insights reflect user behavior, attitudes, and context.

Influence & Integration

  • Translate insights into frameworks, personas, journey maps, or recommendations that support product decisions and roadmap prioritization.
  • Present findings clearly and persuasively to cross-functional teams, fostering a shared understanding of user needs.
  • Build empathy through storytelling, facilitated workshops, and embedded collaboration with teams.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with design, product, engineering, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure user insights are integrated into design and business processes.
  • Collaborate with research peers to refine internal methodologies, templates, and best practices.
  • Advocate for research and champion the voice of the user in key planning and product decisions, helping shape the culture of user-centered development.

Initiative & Work Ethic

  • Self-starter who takes ownership and proactively identifies research opportunities that drive value for both users and the business.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills; you follow through on commitments.
  • Willingness to dive deep into complex, technical domains (e.g., space systems, defense operations, satellite tracking)
  • Present and engaged with internal teams and external users, fostering trust and deep understanding.

Pre-flight Checklist

  • Must be eligible to obtain or maintain US Government Security Clearance, preference given for active TS Clearance.
  • 3+ years of experience in UX research or a related field (e.g., design research, HCI, behavioral science, product design) with increasing scope and autonomy.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Sociology, Design, or a related field. Advanced degrees are a plus as is continued learning through research training, behavioral science certifications, or academic coursework.
  • Experience planning and executing end-to-end studies across both generative and evaluative research methods.
  • Proven ability to influence decisions through clear insights, storytelling, and data alignment.

Bonus Cargo

  • Stakeholder collaboration and influence
  • Journey mapping, persona creation, and insight frameworks
  • Tool proficiency (Figma, Dovetail, UserTesting, Miro, Lyssna, etc.)
  • Research ops awareness (participant management, templates, tagging, documentation)
  • Flexible in approach—can balance rigor with scrappiness depending on context
  • Consistent learning mindset with strong awareness of UX trends, methods, and ethical research practices
  • Communication skills: excellence in verbal and written communication to drive the most effective exchange with stakeholders, including customers, partners, and investors
  • Business skills: acumen of business principles and decision making
  • Strong understanding and experience with design thinking, human centered design and the product development process
  • Domain experience in aerospace, geospatial tech, 3D visualization, or real-time decision tools is a plus

We're building a constellation here, not looking for identical satellites. Every member of the team brings different capabilities to the same mission. If your orbit intersects with ours and you're mission-ready, send it.

US-based Candidates: we are currently only able to hire residents of the following U.S. states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, DC, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KS, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, RI, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV We are unable to consider candidates residing in other U.S. states at this time.

Internationally-based Candidates: we are currently only able to hire residents of the following locations: United Kingdom. We are unable to consider candidates residing in other countries at this time.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion are key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who share a passion for creating a safer, more connected world. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also national origin, citizenship, sex, color, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic that is part of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and we embrace individuality.

raw.description:
About LearnLux

LearnLux is the leading provider of workplace financial wellbeing that blends fiduciary digital planning with access to one-on-one guidance from Certified Financial Planner™️ professionals. LearnLux's award-winning program equips employees with a financial plan to guide them through decision points like budgeting, paying down debt, electing benefits, understanding equity compensation, starting a family, buying a home, saving for retirement, and more. Advanced reporting keeps our partners in the know, and drives results like reduction in financial stress, increased productivity, reduced employee turnover, greater use of pretax products, on-time retirement, and healthcare savings. LearnLux members feel great about their money, allowing their work and wellbeing to thrive.

We’re a remote-first company, backed by prominent investors such as Ashton Kutcher’s fund Sound Ventures and Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff.

The Role

As LearnLux’s Enterprise Account Executive, you will serve as a key driver of our growth by leading strategic sales efforts with Fortune 1,000 and multinational employers. This hands-on role owns the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to presentation, proposal, and close. You’ll manage complex buying processes, build strong relationships with executive stakeholders, and position LearnLux as the leading financial wellbeing solution in the market.

You will be a critical contributor to how we scale revenue in a high-growth, B2B2C, enterprise-focused environment. This role is ideal for a consultative sales professional who thrives in relationship building, strategic account management, and closing high-value opportunities.

This is a full-time, remote position which will require 25-30% travel.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive net new revenue by owning the end-to-end enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Build and manage a strategic pipeline of Fortune 1000 and multinational employer prospects, leveraging both outbound and inbound sources.
  • Conduct consultative discovery to deeply understand prospect pain points and tailor LearnLux solutions to meet their unique business, benefits, and workforce needs.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, demos, and proposals to senior executives, including HR, Total Rewards, Benefits, and Procurement leaders.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Client Success, Product, and Operations teams to ensure alignment and maximize success.
  • Navigate complex procurement and RFP processes, developing high-quality submissions with support from proposal and revenue operations teams.
  • Build trusted relationships with benefits consultants, brokers, and channel partners to increase awareness and influence in the market.
  • Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting within CRM.
  • Represent LearnLux at industry conferences, webinars, and client-facing events.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5–7+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales or equivalent, ideally within employee benefits, Digital Health, HR tech, or fintech.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quota.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN).
  • Experience running complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across HR, Finance, and Procurement.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills with C-level and senior HR/Benefits executives.
  • Comfortable navigating RFPs and procurement processes.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Familiarity with the benefits ecosystem and consultant/broker landscape is a plus.
  • Passion for improving employee wellbeing and making a meaningful impact.

Benefits

  • Remote-first company structure
  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • 401(k)
  • Mental wellbeing (Talkspace)
  • Financial wellbeing (LearnLux)
  • Paid vacation and sick leave
  • Paid sabbatical after 5 years of service
  • A supportive, inclusive team culture
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth at a fast-growing startup at the cutting edge intersection of financial wellness and technology

Closing

LearnLux strives to be an inclusive workplace and values learning from and engaging across different perspectives. Women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and members of other minority or marginalized groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

LearnLux is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against candidates on the basis of race, ethnicity, color, national origin, age, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

We are committed to fostering an environment that embraces diversity and inclusion and are seeking candidates from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives to join our team. If you are interested in this opportunity but not sure if you fit this role, please apply and include a note to let us know of your interest. We’re excited to speak with you about joining our team!

raw.description:
募集要項

業務内容

ROUTE06（ルートシックス）は、大手企業のビジネスモデル変革を支援するDXパートナーです。

エンタープライズ向けビジネスAPIプラットフォーム「Plain」の提供とアジャイルでの事業化支援によって商取引のプラットフォーム化を実現し、新たな企業価値を生み出すことに貢献します。

ROUTE06が提供するエンタープライズ・ソフトウェア基盤は、商取引のプラットフォーム化に必要な機能を包括的に提供するシステムを目指し、現在はBtoBの商取引に重点を置きつつ実際のプロジェクトに伴走しながら開発を進めています。

ROUTE06のバックエンドエンジニアは、価値提供先となる事業ドメインの横断的理解とそれに必要なコラボレーション、システムアーキテクチャの設計と開発、システムの信頼性向上やパフォーマンス改善、CI/CDの整備やオペレーション自動化などの開発生産性向上に向けた開発など、幅広い行動選択肢の中から、チームで相談しつつ適性/希望/需要に応じて柔軟に選択し、顧客企業やエンドユーザーにとって最適かつ最善なUXを提供できるよう開発を進めます。

必須要件

  • Webアプリケーションフレームワークでの実装経験
  • 中規模以上のプロダクトの開発・運用経験、また技術選定やコードベースを改善した経験
  • Gitなどのバージョン管理システムを利用したチームでの開発経験

歓迎要件

  • Ruby on RailsでWebアプリケーションを開発した経験
  • RSpec、MiniTest等を用いたテストコードの実務経験
  • フロントエンド技術の基本的な知識 (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
  • コンテナ仮想化技術を使って開発・運用した経験
  • AWSの利用経験
  • パフォーマンスチューニングの経験
  • 中規模以上のアプリケーションのアーキテクチャ設計に関わった経験

技術環境

以下、現状の利用実績・予定を記載しつつ、プロジェクトによって最適なものを選定し続けます。

  • 開発言語: Ruby
  • フレームワーク: Ruby on Rails
  • データベース: PostgreSQLなど
  • その他の技術要素: AWS、GraphQL、Terraformなど

求める人物像

  • リモートワークでの仕事との経験があり、それに適した振る舞いや情報共有できる方
  • お互いの仕事への理解と敬意を重視した柔らかいコミュニケーションを大切にしている方

選考フロー

選考はすべてオンラインで実施します。日本各地からぜひご応募ください。

選考プロセス

カジュアル面談→書類選考→面接→業務委託契約締結

雇用条件

雇用形態

  • 業務委託

勤務地

  • 在宅勤務を原則としています

勤務体系

  • 10時〜19時を基本とし、自由に選択していただけます
  • 週3日以上の稼働が可能な方

給与

  • スキル・経験・能力に応じて決定いたします

Als digital-first Partner der Steuerberatung gestalten wir die Zukunft der Steuerberatung und Buchhaltung: Automatisiert, AI-unterstützt, mit eigenen Tools und klarer Spezialisierung auf Startups und KMU. Gleichzeitig bauen wir den attraktivsten Arbeitsplatz für Talente im Steuerbereich.

Aufgaben

  • Selbstständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen (digital & mandantenübergreifend)
  • Pflege und Verwaltung der Personalstammdaten sowie Melde- und Bescheinigungswesen
  • Ansprechpartner:in für Mandanten bei lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlichen Fragen
  • Kommunikation mit Behörden, Krankenkassen und unserer Partner-Steuerkanzlei
  • Unterstützung beim Aufbau und der Optimierung digitaler Payroll-Prozesse
  • Mitarbeit an der Integration von HR-Tools (z. B. Personio, DATEV, Lexoffice)
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Produktteam zur Automatisierung von Prozessen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte:r, Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhalter:in oder vergleichbare kaufmännische Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, idealerweise in einer Steuerberatung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
  • Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV LODAS/Lohn und Gehalt, alternativ Erfahrung mit Personio, Lexoffice oder ähnlichen HR-/Payroll-Systemen
  • Freude an digitalen Tools, Automatisierung und modernen Arbeitsweisen
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Teamorientierung

Benefits

  • Teil eines kleinen, spezialisierten Teams an der Schnittstelle von Steuerberatung & Digitalisierung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Geschäftsführung, Steuerberater:innen der Partnerkanzlei sowie Produkt- und Tech-Kolleg:innen
  • Offene Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Eigenverantwortung
  • Kein Mikromanagement – stattdessen Vertrauen und echte Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten
  • 100% Remote

Klingt spannend? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam die digitale Steuerberatung von morgen zu gestalten! 🚀

raw.excerpt: Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them.
raw.description:
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere. Our AI-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.

Are you an experienced localization professional or linguistic QA specialist?

We are seeking seasoned Farsi Linguistic Testers with a background in software localization and IT terminology to join our global linguistic community. In this role, you will perform linguistic QA on cutting-edge software applications and AI models for the Farsi market. If you bring strong LQA experience, deep cultural expertise, and own an M-Series Mac, we want to partner with you.

Position Overview

  • Language Pair: English to Farsi
  • Domain: Information Technology (IT), AI Models & Software Localization
  • Experience Level: Experienced (2+ years in Linguistic QA or Linguistic Testing)
  • Hardware Requirement: Must own a Mac device with an M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer). Note: This is an absolute technical requirement for our secure testing environment.
  • Employment type: Freelance / Independent contractor

Responsibilities

As a Senior Farsi Linguistic Tester, you will:

  • Execute Linguistic QA: Conduct rigorous linguistic, stylistic, and functional testing on localized Farsi software interfaces and AI-generated content.
  • Bug Tracking & Reporting: Identify, log, and regress linguistic errors, visual layout glitches (e.g. truncations, rendering/font issues, alignment), and functional defects using standard issue-tracking workflows.
  • Terminology & Style Guide Enforcement: Ensure absolute adherence to project glossaries, style guides, and brand-specific localization standards.
  • Contextual & Cultural Validation: Verify that localized content is culturally appropriate, idiomatically precise, and tailored for the Farsi market.
  • Collaborate with Lead Engineers: Provide constructive feedback and linguistic solutions to remote localization managers and QA leads in clear English.

Requirements

To qualify for this position, candidates must meet the following criteria:

  • Professional Experience: Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in Linguistic QA, software localization testing, proofreading, or professional translation (English into Farsi).
  • Linguistic Proficiency: Native fluency in Farsi with exceptional command of grammar, typography, and orthography, paired with professional-level written English skills.
  • Hardware Specification (Mandatory): Active access to a Mac computer equipped with an Apple Silicon M-series chip (M1, M2, M3, M4, or newer).
  • LQA Methodology: Proven ability to differentiate between critical linguistic bugs, cosmetic layout defects, and preferential stylistic changes.
  • Cultural Competency: A strong, intuitive grasp of modern Farsi cultural nuances, localized language trends, and regional idiomatic expressions.
  • Technical Aptitude: Comfort navigating new software interfaces, adhering to detailed testing guidelines, and reporting technical/linguistic bugs clearly in English.
  • Work Environment: A reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote, independent contract work.
  • Attention to Quality: Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to consistently identify minor grammatical, formatting, and user-interface (UI) errors.

Benefits

  • Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.
  • Long-Term Collaboration Opportunities: We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.
  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI-driven translation tools, and global brand content.
  • Elite Projects: Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.

raw.description:
QuickTeam is seeking a skilled and experienced Executive Virtual Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to the COO/CFO, with a strong focus on financial administration and rebate program management. This role combines traditional executive support — calendar management, correspondence, travel, and meeting coordination — with hands-on responsibility for client invoicing, rebate applications, and budget documentation. You'll need exceptional organizational skills, financial literacy, and the ability to manage a diverse set of responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week
  • Fully remote, work from home
  • Salary: R20,000/month, commensurate with skills and experience
  • Availability to work during EST business hours

Responsibilities:

    • Client Invoicing: Prepare and process client invoices accurately and on time.
    • Rebate Budget Forms: Complete and manage budget forms required for rebate applications.
    • Load Letters: Prepare and submit load letters as required by rebate programs.
    • Rebate Applications: Prepare, submit, and track rebate applications from start to finish.
    • Closeout Documentation: Manage rebate closeout documentation and ensure timely submission.
    • Program Research: Research available rebate programs and provide concise summaries and recommendations to the COO.
    • Program Administrator Liaison: Maintain regular communication with rebate program administrators regarding the status of applications and closeouts.
    • Progress Tracking: Update and maintain Google Sheets to accurately track project progress, rebates, and related documentation.
    • Stakeholder Meetings: Attend Microsoft Teams meetings with rebate companies to discuss the status of rebate applications and closeouts.
    • Client Liaison: Liaise with clients to obtain all required documentation for rebate applications.
    • Project Manager Collaboration: Maintain strong communication and collaborate closely with Project Managers throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Ongoing Training: Participate in regular training sessions with the COO to stay up to date on rebate programs, processes, and industry requirements.
    • Calendar Management: Efficiently manage the COO/CFO's complex and ever-changing schedule, including meetings, conference calls, and appointments. Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them.
    • Email and Correspondence: Monitor and prioritize the inbox, draft and respond to emails, and ensure timely and accurate communication with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Travel Arrangements: Arrange travel logistics including flights, accommodations, transportation, and itinerary planning.
    • Meeting Coordination: Prepare agendas, coordinate logistics, take minutes, track action items, and follow up on outstanding tasks.
    • Confidentiality and Discretion: Handle sensitive and confidential financial and business information with the highest level of integrity.
    • Documentation and Filing: Organize and maintain files, records, and documentation, both electronic and physical, ensuring easy retrieval.
    • Research and Analysis: Conduct research, gather data, and prepare reports and briefing materials to support decision-making.

Requirements

    • 3+ years' experience as an Executive Assistant, or equivalent experience in finance/accounts administration
    • Demonstrated experience with invoicing, reconciliations, or financial document preparation
    • Strong proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel for tracking budgets, projects, and documentation
    • Experience with, or strong aptitude for, application or grant/rebate-style administrative processes (intake, documentation tracking, status reporting, and closeout)
    • Comfortable communicating with external program administrators and stakeholders via email and Microsoft Teams
    • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • Ability to work autonomously and take initiative in a fast-paced environment
    • Discretion and professionalism in handling sensitive financial and business information
    • A proactive, detail-oriented mindset with a willingness to learn and grow
    • Comfortable working EST business hours

raw.description:
Position: Director of Supply Chain
Department: Supply Chain & Logistics
Employer Company: EAK Distribution
Reports To: COO / Integrator
Job Type: Full Time, Remote
Salary: Up to $4000
Work Hours: 8 AM - 12 PM EST, with flexibility to coordinate with external partners in PST and occasional communication with Chinese suppliers.

Role (Overview of the Position)

The Director of Supply Chain is a senior leadership role responsible for building and managing the end-to-end supply chain infrastructure that will scale HOME GROWN from ~$20M to $100M+ in revenue. This position owns the full physical flow of goods: raw material procurement (domestic and international), vendor management including overseas finished goods suppliers, production coordination with Heirloom Organics, inventory planning and demand forecasting, inbound/outbound logistics, and multi-channel fulfillment across Amazon FBA, TikTok Shop (MCF and FBT), Shopify, Home Depot dropship, and future retail partners.

Reporting to the COO/Integrator, the Director of Supply Chain leads the logistics team, owns the supply chain budget, and serves as the primary driver of ERP selection and implementation. This role must build the systems, processes, and team capable of supporting 600+ SKUs within two years while maintaining a stockout rate below 1%.

This is not a maintenance role. The company is in a high-growth phase with expanding channels, a vertically integrated manufacturing facility, and plans to 5x revenue. The Director of Supply Chain must be someone who has built supply chain infrastructure at scale and thrives in environments where the playbook has not been written yet.

Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

Demand Planning & Inventory Strategy

  • Own the demand planning function across all channels and all SKUs (180 today, scaling to 600+ within two years).
  • Build and maintain rolling demand forecasts that integrate sales velocity, seasonality, promotional calendars, and channel expansion timelines.
  • Maintain a stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs while minimizing overstock and dead inventory.
  • Establish safety stock models, reorder points, and lead time buffers for each product category and channel.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Brand Management, andProduct Development to align forecasts with planned launches, promotions, and channel expansions.

Procurement & Vendor Management

  • Consolidate and own all procurement across entities: raw seeds (via Heirloom Organics), envelopes, mylars, soil, pots, packaging materials, and finished goods from overseas and domestic suppliers.
  • Manage international supplier relationships including overseas finished goods vendors: lead times, import logistics, customs/duties, and quality assurance.
  • Negotiate supplier contracts, pricing, lead times, and quality standards.
  • Build a diversified vendor base that reduces single-source risk as SKU count scales.
  • Manage purchase order workflows and ensure alignment between procurement spend and approved budgets.

Heirloom Organics Production Coordination

  • Serve as the primary supply chain interface with Mark (Operations Lead) and the Heirloom Organics team in Grants Pass, OR.
  • Translate demand forecasts into production requirements and ensure production schedules align with fulfillment timelines.
  • Track production output against commitments. Escalate and problem-solve when production falls behind plan.
  • Collaborate on capacity planning as SKU count and volume grow, including equipment utilization (seed counters, bag packers, labeling lines).

Logistics & Fulfillment

  • Oversee all inbound freight (vendor to warehouse/FBA/FBT) and outbound fulfillment operations.
  • Manage Amazon FBA compliance: IPI score maintenance (450+), restock limits, stranded inventory resolution, shipment plan optimization.
  • Manage TikTok Shop fulfillment across both Amazon MCF and Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT), including inventory allocation to TikTok warehouses.
  • Optimize B2C direct-to-consumer fulfillment for Shopify and TikTok orders. Determine when orders should ship from 3PL, Heirloom Organics directly, or FBA/FBT. Specifically optimize multi-unit order fulfillment to reduce per-unit shipping costs.
  • Oversee Home Depot dropship fulfillment and future retail channel logistics.
  • Optimize freight costs, carrier relationships, and shipping workflows.
  • Manage 3PL relationships and evaluate when direct fulfillment from HO is more cost-effective.

ERP Selection & Implementation

  • Lead the supply chain workstream of ERP evaluation and selection (currently in evaluation phase).
  • Define requirements for inventory management, procurement, production planning, and order management modules.
  • Own the supply chain side of ERP implementation: data migration, workflow configuration, team training, and go-live execution.
  • Ensure the ERP delivers real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Budget & Cost Management

  • Own the full supply chain budget: freight, raw materials, packaging, 3PL costs, and logistics overhead.
  • Track spend against budget with no more than +/-5% variance.
  • Identify and execute cost reduction opportunities across freight, procurement, and fulfillment without compromising service levels.
  • Report on supply chain unit economics and COGS trends to the COO and Controller.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Directly manage Asad (Logistics Manager) and Faiqa (Logistics Analyst).
  • Provide oversight and evaluation of Ather (Logistics Coordinator) and Faisal to assess fit and readiness for scale.
  • Assess the current team structure and capabilities against the requirements of a 600+ SKU, $100M operation. Identify gaps and build a hiring plan.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with all direct reports. Establish clear KPIs and accountability for each role.
  • Foster a culture of operational discipline, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.

Results (Expected Accomplishments)

Inventory & Availability

  • Maintain stockout rate below 1% across all active SKUs and channels.
  • Achieve demand forecast accuracy of 85%+ within the first 12 months.
  • Maintain Amazon IPI score at 450+ consistently.
  • Establish forward visibility of 8+ weeks on potential stockouts.

Procurement & Cost

  • Consolidate all procurement under a single function within the first 90 days.
  • Maintain or improve COGS as a percentage of revenue versus prior year.
  • Maintain supply chain budget within +/-5% variance.

Systems & Infrastructure

  • Complete ERP evaluation and selection within the first 90 days.
  • Lead supply chain ERP implementation to go-live.
  • Deliver real-time inventory visibility across all entities and channels.

Heirloom Organics Alignment

  • Establish a weekly production alignment cadence with Heirloom Organics within the first 30 days.
  • Achieve 90%+ production schedule adherence against demand-driven production plans.

Team & Operational Readiness

  • Complete a team assessment within 60 days: document capabilities, gaps, and a hiring/development plan for scaling to 600+ SKUs.
  • 100% of direct reports have documented roles (4R documents), clear KPIs, and weekly 1:1s.
  • Fulfillment SLA compliance at 98%+ across all channels.

Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

Experience

  • 7+ years in supply chain, logistics, or operations management with at least 3 years in a senior/director-level role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing supply chains with hundreds of SKUs and complex raw material inputs (e-commerce or CPG strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated experience scaling supply chain infrastructure from ~$20M to $50M+ in revenue.
  • Track record of managing end-to-end supply chains: raw material procurement, finished goods sourcing (including international/overseas suppliers), inventory planning, fulfillment, and logistics.
  • Experience selecting and implementing ERP or inventory management systems.
  • Experience managing or closely coordinating with manufacturing/production operations.

Skills

  • Strong demand planning and inventory optimization capabilities. Comfortable building forecast models and safety stock frameworks.
  • Deep understanding of Amazon FBA operations: IPI management, restock limits, shipment planning, and stranded inventory.
  • Proficiency with supply chain analytics and reporting. Able to translate complex logistics data into clear leadership updates.
  • Vendor negotiation and contract management.
  • ERP/WMS/IMS fluency. Ability to define requirements, evaluate vendors, and lead implementation.
  • Budget ownership and P&L management experience.

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to build, assess, and develop logistics teams. Not just managing what is inherited, but evaluating talent for scale readiness and making hard calls.
  • Ability to influence cross-functionally, including production teams without a direct reporting line.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. Can operate effectively in a remote-first, async-heavy environment.
  • Systems thinker who can zoom out from daily execution to identify structural risks and build for scale.

Cultural Fit

  • Aligned with HOME GROWN core values: Radical Transparency, Disciplined Growth, Compounded Trust, Measured Decisions, Intentional Execution, Collective Excellence.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments where processes are being built, not maintained.
  • Comfortable with EOS methodology (L10 meetings, Rocks, Scorecards, Accountability Charts).
  • Self-directed and accountable. Does not require micromanagement to deliver results.

raw.description:
Upwave: The Brand Outcomes Measurement Platform

Upwave is a leading measurement company entirely focused on measuring and optimizing upper funnel campaigns.. The world’s leading advertisers, agencies, and media partners trust Upwave’s robust, AI-driven platform to bring science to the top of the funnel.

With Upwave, marketers maximize the effectiveness of brand spend. Upwave measures Brand Lift, validates Brand Reach, and surfaces Brand Optimization opportunities in one, dynamic platform with cross-channel brand measurement for CTV, Digital, Social, Linear, Addressable, Retail Media, Streaming Audio and more.

We’re a profitable, growth-stage company backed by leading venture investors (Y Combinator, Uncork Capital, Bloomberg Beta, Initialized Capital, PivotNorth, Ridge Ventures, Industry Ventures, Conductive Ventures,) and leading AdTechfounders & CEOs.

We’re a humble but ambitious team that takes its work seriously but never ourselves. Come join us.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Upwave, you’ll be a full-stack problem solver with a backend focus—building the APIs, data pipelines, and systems that power our brand measurement platform. Your work will process billions of ad impressions, manage complex data workflows, and deliver insights that inform marketing decisions for the world’s biggest brands.

You’ll collaborate across engineering, product, and data science to ship high-impact features end-to-end, scale our platform for the next phase of growth, and help define the next generation of brand measurement.

What you will do:

Build AI-powered customer experiences — integrate LLMs and advanced causal inference techniques into production workflows that automatically generate data visualizations, synthesize campaign performance into natural language insights, and help enterprise customers understand and optimize their advertising through our AI analyst "Bayes."

Design and build scalable backend systems —develop microservices and RESTful APIs that power the analytics platform behind the world’s top brand campaigns.

Contribute across the stack — work from backend APIs to Python analytics services to React frontends, delivering complete features that combine sophisticated data analysis with intuitive user experiences.

Engineer data pipelines at scale — design and operate systems that process massive volumes of ad and survey data with MySQL, DynamoDB, and AWS (S3, Lambda, EMR, Kinesis Firehose).

Improve reliability and performance — deploy services on Kubernetes and AWS, automate deployments via CI/CD, monitor with DataDog and Sentry, and continuously raise the bar for operational excellence

Collaborate deeply — work closely with Product and Data Science to productionize statistical models, integrate advanced analytics into customer-facing tools, and bring cutting-edge AI capabilities to enterprise customers.

Deliver insights that move millions — enable brand lift analytics and real-time campaign insights by building reliable, high-throughput systems. Multi-million dollar advertising decisions hinge on our recommendations.

About you:

You’re an experienced engineer (5+ years) who thrives on solving complex problems across APIs, data systems, and distributed infrastructure. You care about clean architecture, reliable systems, and measurable customer impact.

You’ve built powerful, intuitive, API-driven products for professional users.. You’re comfortable across the stack, with experience in RDBMS-backed backends using Spring Boot, Django, Rails, or Express, and single-page frontends built in React, Vue, or Angular.

You understand and enjoy programming. You’re fluent in the modern landscape of UI frameworks, API and microservice architectures, databases, and cloud platforms—and know when to use the right tool for the job.

You embrace modern AI-powered development tools to move faster and code smarter. You use technologies like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub CoPilot to automate routine work, explore ideas quickly, and focus your time on higher-value system design and innovation.

You value structured software development practices—testing, documentation, CI/CD, and code review—and care about building maintainable systems that scale.

You believe developers should operate what they build. You think about observability, cost, and reliability from day one, and design systems that are easy to deploy and maintain. You’ve built in the cloud and know both its power and pitfalls.

You like turning ideas into tools that make real customers more effective. You collaborate closely with Product to design features that solve real-world problems and delight users.

You mentor others, share knowledge freely, and understand that healthy human systems are the foundation of healthy technical systems. Teammates look to you for guidance.

You want to understand how things work and why. You care more about the best idea winning than whose idea it is.

You take responsibility, move quickly to fix problems, and take pride in establishing areas of deep expertise in a fast-changing environment.

You believe high-trust, inclusive teams outperform individuals. You communicate clearly and compassionately, and contribute to a culture where people enjoy working together.

Bonus points:

Have worked with modern backend ecosystems like Java/Kotlin/Groovy (Spring Boot or Grails) and know how to design APIs that scale elegantly.

Are fluent with data systems such as MySQL, DynamoDB, and Presto, and understand the tradeoffs between relational and NoSQL storage.

Have built cloud-native applications on AWS, especially using Kubernetes and Terraform for automation and scalability.

Know your way around modern front-end frameworks like React/Redux and enjoy collaborating up and down the stack.

Have startup DNA—you’re comfortable with ambiguity, iterate fast, and make pragmatic technical decisions.

Bring experience from AdTech, MarTech, or measurement platforms, or are excited to learn how AI and large-scale data intersect in this space.

Please note: Our interview process will require an in-person meeting.

Why You’ll Like Working Here:

Engineering-first company: Upwave’s success depends on high-velocity innovation, and we believe high velocity comes from high efficiency, not high effort. We set priorities rather than deadlines, we don’t crunch, we work reasonable hours, and engineers actually take vacations.

Modern tech stack: Python analytics, Kotlin/Java APIs, event streaming (100k+ RPM), DynamoDB, Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, LLM orchestration.

Impact at scale: Your code processes billions of advertising events and directly influences multi-million dollar decisions by Fortune 500 brands.

Autonomy and ownership: Our engineers lead projects from design through deployment and monitoring.

Ambitious but humble culture: We take our work seriously but never ourselves. Upwavers collaborate hard and support each other generously. We screen for people who are both exceptionally talented and genuinely kind.

Remote-first team: Our diverse team spans half the globe (but only one half, to ensure everyone can talk live when we need to). We balance synchronous core hours with flexibility to create a work environment that enables both deep collaboration and deep work.

Additional Information:

The annual base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for the new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Upwave is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Job Title: Business Analyst (Agile)

Location: Caribbean/Remote

Role Summary

The Agile Business Analyst will be a key partner to the internet and mobile banking teams, driving the successful delivery of agile projects that enhance digital banking experiences. This role bridges business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring solutions are customer- centric, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The Agile BA will champion agile practices, facilitate rapid iteration, and support continuous improvement in a dynamic financial services environment. They will develop a deep understanding of the product and provide the business context with a focus on the end-to-end process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Agile Requirements Elicitation & Analysis: Collaborate with product owners, stakeholders, and development teams to gather, refine, and prioritize user stories and requirements. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives). Translate business needs into clear, actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
  • Business Process Improvement: Analyze current digital banking processes, identify pain points, and recommend enhancements leveraging agile methodologies. Support automation, digitization, and regulatory compliance in solution design. Identify potential impacts of proposed designs to any element of the end-to-end process.
  • Solution Design & Validation: Work with cross-functional teams to design and validate solutions that meet business and customer needs. Participate in solution evaluation, ensuring alignment with agile principles and maximizing value delivery.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Develop stakeholder maps and communication plans tailored to agile project environments. Act as a liaison between business and technical teams, ensuring transparency and shared understanding.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Support the creation and execution of test plans, including user acceptance testing (UAT) and continuous feedback loops. Troubleshoot issues and facilitate rapid resolution during sprints.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain agile documentation (user stories, process maps, release notes). Facilitate training and onboarding for new systems and processes. Identify new procedures and job aids to be developed or impacts to existing documentation.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Provide insights through data analysis to inform decision- making and measure project success.
  • Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, leveraging agile metrics (velocity, burndown charts) and feedback

Critical Skills & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years experience as a Business Analyst on agile projects, preferably in financial services or digital banking.
  • Proven track record supporting internet/mobile banking initiatives.

Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Proficiency in agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Trello).
  • Experience with process mapping (BPMN), user story writing, and backlog management.
  • Clear understanding of technical concepts, including familiarity with APIs, mobile/web technologies, and SDLC.
  • Data analysis and visualization skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong knowledge of business analysis methodologies (e.g., BABOK).
  • Proficiency in producing quality requirements and process deliverables (e.g., BRDs, use cases, user stories, process maps) and other related documentation.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and modeling tools (e.g., Visio) and techniques.

Key Competencies

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving in fast-paced, agile environments.
  • Ability to apply structured, logical, and data-driven approaches to understand complex business problems and deliver actionable insights.
  • Consistently demonstrates the ability to work autonomously, proactively seeking out information and resources to understand tasks and deliver results
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities, makes informed decisions, and manages assignments with minimal supervision or reliance on others for context or direction.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Adaptability and resilience in dynamic project settings.
  • Commitment to industry best practices (IIBA BABOK, Agile Manifesto).

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Certified Product Owner (CSPO), IIBA Agile Analysis Certification (IIBA-AAC), or equivalent.
  • Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) or PMI-PBA certification.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewDriven by surging demand for immersive and volumetric content, as well as new perspectives that can unlock creative storytelling, Muybridge is commercialising a genuinely novel technology platform across sports broadcast, premium studio production, and live entertainment.
raw.description:
Role Overview

Driven by surging demand for immersive and volumetric content, as well as new perspectives that can unlock creative storytelling, Muybridge is commercialising a genuinely novel technology platform across sports broadcast, premium studio production, and live entertainment. This comes at a defining moment for the broadcast industry: after decades of relative stability, the convergence of GPU computing, computer vision, and autonomous production is fundamentally reshaping how content is captured, produced, and distributed. The buyers, workflows, and value chains that defined the last generation are being rewritten and Muybridge is at the centre of that shift. This is a rare opportunity to be first in - building a territory, owning a pipeline, and closing landmark deals that define a category.

The Director of Business Development - Europe will be the primary commercial presence across the region. Operating from a home office, you will represent Muybridge independently across a complex, multi-stakeholder value chain: leagues, clubs, venues, broadcasters, production service companies, studio operators, and live event producers. You will carry an annual revenue quota and be expected to over-deliver on it.

Success in this role requires working on two levels simultaneously: managing and developing channel partnerships - the service companies, systems integrators, and broadcast partners through whom deals are often structured and delivered, while also creating demand and building conviction at the top of the value chain with rights holders, leagues, federations, and executive decision-makers. You will be expected to be present at key live deployments, acting as the commercial face of Muybridge on-site, strengthening partner and client relationships in the field, and supporting the deployment team when needed.

This is a senior, self-sufficient role - one for someone equally comfortable in a boardroom and a broadcast truck. You will carry technical conversations with prospects, supported remotely by our technical team, and close enterprise-level deals that often span multiple decision-makers and long sales cycles. You report directly to the CCO.

What You'll Do

Revenue Generation & Channel Partner Development

  • Own and manage a structured European pipeline, forecasting accurately and reporting to the CCO on a regular cadence.
  • Meet and exceed an annual sales quota through a combination of new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts.
  • Develop account plans for key strategic targets and execute against them with discipline and creativity.
  • Maintain a rigorous and up-to-date record of all conversations, opportunities, and account activity in the company's CRM system, ensuring full pipeline visibility for the leadership team.
  • Prepare, submit, and negotiate commercial proposals and offers, managing the full arc from initial qualification through to signed agreement.
  • Steer legal documents and partnership agreements to closure, working closely with the CCO and internal stakeholders to navigate complex contract structures and multi-party negotiations.
  • Conduct business and commercial modelling to assess deal economics, validate pricing structures, and ensure sustainable value creation for both Muybridge and its customers and partners.
  • Serve as the regional voice on market dynamics, competitor activity, pricing feedback, and emerging customer need.
  • Contribute to commercial strategy, proposal development, and partnership structuring discussions with the CCO and leadership team.

You will deploy this commercial approach across three priority verticals. The three verticals below represent Muybridge's current priority markets in order of revenue focus. As the platform scales, so will the addressable opportunity - spanning additional industries where computer vision and volumetric capture will reshape how content is created and consumed.

1. Sports Broadcast

  • Develop and close opportunities across the European sports broadcast ecosystem: leagues, federations, clubs, venues, host broadcasters, rights holders, production service partners, and technology partners.
  • Build and manage relationships with rights holders and broadcast partners across key sports properties.
  • Navigate complex multi-party value chains where technology, rights, and production responsibilities are distributed across several organisations.
  • Represent Muybridge at industry events, trade shows, and broadcast forums across the region.

2. Studio & Network Production

  • Identify and develop opportunities with TV networks, streaming platforms (Netflix, Amazon, Apple TV+ and equivalents), and independent production companies with the intent of promoting and adopting a novel way to capture content that was previously impossible - unlocking new perspectives and introducing new forms of storytelling.
  • Target sports studios, news operations, scripted and unscripted productions, and film projects where the Muybridge platform creates a step-change in production value or workflow.
  • Build relationships with creative directors, heads of production, technical directors, and commissioning executives across broadcast and streaming.

3. Live Events & Entertainment

  • Develop pipeline across the live events sector: major music tours, festivals, arena entertainment, and high-profile cultural productions seeking next-generation capture capabilities.
  • Partner with promoters, venues, production companies, and brand experience agencies to integrate Muybridge technology into premium live productions.

What We're Looking For

  • 8–12 years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, or commercial partnerships within sports media, broadcast technology, studio production, or live entertainment, or a combination of these.
  • A proven track record of hitting and exceeding revenue targets in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments.
  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, media, and live production — able to hold a credible technical conversation without engineering support in the room. A working understanding of broadcast workflows, signal chains, or production infrastructure is a meaningful advantage.
  • Existing network across European broadcasters, leagues, streaming platforms, or production companies is a strong advantage.
  • Experience selling novel or emerging technology into conservative or risk-averse buyers — you know how to build conviction around something new.
  • Highly self-directed: able to build pipeline from scratch, manage your own schedule, and operate without daily management support.
  • Willing and able to travel frequently across Europe and occasionally internationally.
  • Based in Western Europe; UK strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • These are the first dedicated commercial roles at Muybridge, and the people who fill them will form the core of the commercial leadership team as the company scales.
  • You will be a vital commercial presence in Europe for a technology that lives in a unique moment with no direct competitor and is deeply protected by patents — the category is yours to define.
  • You will work directly with the CCO and leadership team, with short decision-making cycles and real influence on commercial strategy.
  • You will close deals that appear in major broadcast productions and live events seen by millions.
  • Competitive base salary with a 50/50 performance-based structure designed to reward significant over-performance.
  • You will join at a pivotal moment - Series A closed, commercially proven, and ready to scale.

raw.description:
Copia Wealth Studios is seeking customer-facing leaders to help us build a world-class concierge service for our patrons. Successful candidates will forge new divisions, make inroads with our patrons, and define best practices.

The Principal Concierge is a patron-facing role serving as the primary point of contact for all service-related needs of Copia's clients. The Concierge team will work in a complex, team-oriented, fast-paced environment alongside the Copia team, our patrons, and 3rd party partners.

We have four core values that we believe make the ideal teammate:

  • Be Humble.

  • Be Humane.

  • Be Hungry.

  • Be Holistic.

Our first Product is a financial intelligence platform. The platform helps high-net-worth individuals (business owners, family offices, entrepreneurs, and athletes) manage their investments. Our 'Patrons' track everything from art to crypto to real estate and business assets.

The team comprises veterans who have been shipping products for decades; we've been designing and developing native iOS apps since the dawn of the iOS SDK. We've already unlocked early product-market fit, we're fully funded, and we have plenty of runway to match our ambitions.

The position is a "blue sky" space that will shape the future of our patron interactions. Our patrons come from a wide variety of backgrounds, with varying levels of expertise. A successful Concierge candidate will provide strategic oversight while onboarding patrons, ingesting documents, supporting/clarifying functionality, and working closely with other delivery teams.

About You

You are a social butterfly. You love supporting multi-disciplinary teams and harbor deep human empathy. You value autonomy and love being on a team where you contribute directly to the problem at hand. You love challenging assumptions and coming through for customers day in, day out.

Your Knowledge:

  • You have a solid grasp of the alternative investment landscape.

  • You have a good sense of humor and believe culture matters.

  • You love learning and want to be on a team that will challenge you and gives you the freedom to grow.

  • You love the idea of stepping into something that doesn't exist and building greatness from the ground up.

  • You're customer service-oriented with a natural tendency to take care of people.

  • You're free to travel within the United States up to 25% of the time.

Engaging Patrons:

  • You're comfortable under pressure, dealing with ultra-wealthy patrons.

  • You love leading a team and building inroads across disciplines.

  • You cherish delivering value for customers you interact with.

  • You demonstrate extraordinary patience and perseverance.

  • You know attention to detail and articulate communication is a must.

    Your Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing role, preferably in financial services, private banking, or financial technology (our patrons are Ultra High Net Worth Individuals and Family Offices).

  • A big plus for candidates who hold a CFA, CAIA, or CFP.

  • College/University degree or related work experience preferred.

  • Working knowledge of G-Suite, HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Slack, and any other applicable customer communication technology.

Notable Perks:

  • We're a distributed workforce with lots of experience working in remote teams. That said, we also know the importance of face-to-face. To that end, we host an annual Defrag onsite and allow employees to travel to the closest "hub" to mingle in between Defrags (within reason, pre-approval required).

  • Flexible hours. Most of the team is active during the day, but we don't have set hours. If you need to drop the kids off at school or grab groceries mid-day and would rather clock hours at night, that's cool by us. We recognize work-life balance and understand managing the modern family unit can be messy. We primarily operate in Mountain Time, so we ask that overlap occurs as much as possible for jamming and collaboration.

  • Fun matters, which is why we built "The Wheel of Fortuna," a prize wheel everyone gets to spin when we achieve our goals. It's also why we have weekly happy hours and regular "game nights."

  • Environment matters. You can work wherever you want. In a post COVID world, we plan to establish some office space where teams can come and go as they please, collaborating face to face as needed. We know environment matters, which is why every new hire gets a $1,000 office upgrade budget in addition to meeting their technology needs.

  • Health insurance. We provide competitive coverage for health, dental, vision, and life insurance in both the US and Canada. In the US specifically, we cover 75% of insurance.

  • Mental and physical health matters, which is why each employee is entitled to a $400/year stipend for gym/club/fitness-related membership. Also, we will reimburse you for an annual subscription to whatever meditation/mindfulness/wellness app you prefer.

  • Learning matters, which is why you can expense any (work-related) book you want. Any course under $250 is usually instant approval.

  • Workshop and conferences are handled on a case-by-case basis. However, philosophically we'll do whatever we can to fuel your passion. Historically this means sending people to WWDC, participating in industry events, and joining various workshops. If there's something that you're passionate about that also benefits the team, chances are we're going to approve it.

    What are we doing about inclusion and diversity?

    We're committed to building a team where the talent can do their best work. As such, we're creating an environment of psychological safety where all teammates can be valued, respected, and heard. This role carries full quota ownership with base salary and variable compensation.

You might be the perfect fit for us!

raw.excerpt: Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick TeamFCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.
raw.description:
Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

If this sounds like the opportunity you have been waiting for then APPLY NOW.

Have questions about this opportunity? Reach out to our recruitment team at

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

For this position, you may earn between 2-29% in marginal commission rates based on qualified sales achieved during each month.

Before applying to any internal position you must have been with the company or your current role for a minimum of 6 - 12 months and notify your leader prior to applying.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Center Travel Group USA’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to help make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at

🏆 Travel Weekly Magellan Awards: Silver Winner (2023)
🌟 GBTA WINiT Top 50 Award Recipients (2018–2025)
💫 CHHR: 5-Star DE&I Employer (2023, 2024)
🌍 Seramount, FCTG Mexico: Member of the Global Inclusion Index (2023–25)
📰 Newsweek: America’s Greatest Workplaces for Diversity (2024)
💛 Benefits Canada: Health/Wellness Program and Mental Health Program (2023, 2025)
✈️ OutThere Awards: Inclusive Travel Finalist (2025)
🏅 Canadian HR Awards: Excellence in Diversity and Inclusion Awardee (2025)

Salary: 60,000

Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .

Enterprise Data Conversion Lead

Position Summary:

Reporting to the Director, Operational Integration, the Enterprise Data Conversion Lead owns enterprise data conversion across system implementations, agency integrations, acquisitions, and platform migrations. This role leads readiness, mapping, validation, reconciliation, cutover support, issue resolution, and stabilization to ensure converted data is accurate, operationally usable, and aligned to business, reporting, compliance, commission, financial, and client-service needs across Employee Benefits and P&C brokerage segments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end data conversion workstreams for system implementations, agency integrations, acquisitions, and platform migrations.
  • Own conversion planning, data readiness, mapping coordination, validation, reconciliation, mock conversion, production cutover, and stabilization activities.
  • Translate source-system data, target-platform standards, and business requirements into conversion rules, mapping decisions, validation plans, and remediation priorities.
  • Coordinate business users, agency teams, technology, finance, vendors, and implementation partners to resolve data issues and drive conversion readiness.
  • Manage issue logs, decisions, risks, defects, dependencies, and escalations that may impact conversion quality, business readiness, or operational continuity.
  • Lead validation and reconciliation across key brokerage data domains, including client, policy, carrier, producer, commission, billing, claims, certificate, enrollment, eligibility, census, activity, attachment, and document data.
  • Prepare concise status updates, readiness summaries, risk views, and recommendations for the Director, Operational Integration, and program leadership.
  • Maintain and improve enterprise conversion standards, templates, controls, documentation, and repeatable playbooks.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data conversion, data migration, systems implementation, insurance brokerage operations, business systems, technical project delivery, or related work.
  • Experience leading cross-functional system implementation, acquisition integration, platform migration, or transformation initiatives.

About Plooto

Plooto is a Canada-born fintech company on a mission to give small and mid-sized businesses the financial power to succeed on their own terms. We make payments secure, accurate, and stress-free so businesses and their accountants can spend less time in the books, confidently manage cash flow, and make smarter decisions every day. We're a team that builds with integrity, agility, and heart, and we're looking for customer-minded pros who share our passion to join us as we scale.

About the Role

Location: Remote, India

Employment type: Employer of Record

We're looking for an Account Executive to join our SMB Sales team and help bring Plooto's all-in-one AP/AR payment platform to small and independent businesses across North America. You'll be joining a focused, driven team working through an important chapter in Plooto's growth, with meaningful work to do and real opportunities to develop as the business evolves.

You'll primarily manage a pipeline of warm inbound leads from businesses actively exploring better ways to manage their payments. When the opportunity arises, you'll also engage in targeted outbound outreach, so comfort with both motions is essential. You'll play a direct role in shaping how Plooto grows its SMB customer base.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for SMB prospects, from initial discovery through close, ensuring a consultative and customer-first buying experience.
  • Manage and convert a steady pipeline of inbound leads from businesses looking to automate and simplify their accounts payable and receivable processes.
  • Execute outbound outreach to targeted prospect segments when needed, bringing the same disciplined, customer-first approach to every engagement.
  • Conduct compelling discovery calls and product demonstrations that clearly connect Plooto's platform to each prospect's specific pain points and goals.
  • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene in Salesforce, with accurate pipeline stages, timely disposition logging, and quality deal notes that support team-wide forecasting.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure smooth handoffs and share field insights that improve how we go to market.
  • Consistently meet and exceed monthly performance targets including deals closed, new subscriber numbers, and payment feature activation rates.
  • Share learnings from customer conversations to help sharpen the team's messaging, talk tracks, and objection-handling playbooks.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS or fintech sales experience with a consistent track record of quota attainment.
  • Proven experience selling to small and independent businesses; you understand their buying behaviour, timelines, and decision-making dynamics.
  • Comfortable running both inbound and outbound sales motions; you know how to generate momentum regardless of where a conversation starts.
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills; you ask the right questions, listen actively, and tailor your pitch accordingly.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM; you keep your pipeline clean and use data to manage your time well.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; confident on the phone and equally effective in async channels.

Nice-to-Have

  • Background in payments, accounting software, or financial tools, or prior experience working with accountants and bookkeepers.
  • Experience with sales engagement tools such as outreach sequencing platforms or VoIP tools like Aircall.
  • Prior experience in a high-growth or fast-changing environment where you've had to adapt quickly as the playbook evolved.
  • Familiarity with compliance considerations in financial software sales (e.g., CASL, TCPA).

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you're looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We're transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow, and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You'll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We're just getting started, and you'll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.
